name: What is grout sealing and why is it important?

mainEntity.name: What is grout sealing and why is it important?

acceptedAnswer.text: Grout sealing involves applying a protective barrier to porous grout lines, preventing moisture, dirt, and stains from penetrating the material. Grout, often made from sand and cement, is naturally absorbent. Without a seal, it can quickly become discolored by spills, grime, and mold, making it difficult to clean and potentially compromising the integrity of your tiled surfaces over time. Sealing extends the life of your grout and keeps your tiled areas looking cleaner and more hygienic.
acceptedAnswer.description: Grout sealing applies a protective barrier to porous grout, preventing stains, dirt, and moisture penetration. It maintains cleanliness and extends the life of tiled surfaces.
